role: analytic and synthetic development benchmark; not robot execution
primary_statistic: per-case success fraction over 20 algorithm seeds at each proposal budget
failure_rule: all runs retained; budget exhaustion is failure; no post-result retuning
notes: Bounds are analytic and tight. All methods get the same known task geometry. Repaired TSR additionally applies the exact known coupling correction; its extra operation is recorded. Proposal count is not an equal wall-time budget.
